items.headline: CoreWeave CDS narrows to lowest in over a week but stays above 1,000 bp
items.note: 5-year CDS near 1,041 bp, after a record intraday peak earlier this month, still prices very high default risk for the largest neocloud borrower.

items.headline: CoreWeave is sole tenant for 7 of 20 project-financed high-yield data center bonds ($14.1B)
items.note: Tenant concentration means CoreWeave distress could spread to the data-center high-yield bond market.
